# Parkland Consulting Group

> Parkland Consulting Group is a pattern-led growth strategy consultancy based in Atlanta, Georgia, serving businesses across the United States. Founded by Charnell Smith-Landry. Slogan: "Grow on Patterns, Not Hunches." Parkland helps businesses find the patterns in their customers, teams and numbers, then decide where to grow, how to scale and how to communicate. Restaurants, QSR and multi-unit franchise brands are a specialty; Parkland also works with retail and ecommerce, beauty and wellness, and service businesses.

## About the founder

Charnell Smith-Landry is a growth strategist with a 25-year career in digital, marketing and technology, including more than 15 years of independent consulting. She led the digital guest experience at a fast-growing restaurant brand (app, website, online ordering, loyalty, point of sale and customer data platform). She has worked with Inspire Brands, Tropical Smoothie Cafe, Cox Communications, SunTrust (now Truist), Walk-On's Sports Bistreaux and Smalls Sliders, along with founder-led businesses. She holds a master's degree in project management and a bachelor's degree in computer information systems, and has been a keynote and panel speaker at QSR industry conferences. Clients work directly with Charnell, supported by a bench of designers, full-stack developers, dashboard builders, channel auditors and partners.

## Services

- [Pattern Audit](https://parkland.consulting/services/pattern-audit/): The entry point. A fixed-fee, three-to-four-week review of customers, operations, performance and technology that delivers a readout, a ranked 90-day action plan and a 30-day check-in. Investment starting from $3,000, or two payments of $1,500. 15% off project work booked within two weeks of the readout.
- [Growth Strategy](https://parkland.consulting/services/growth-strategy/): Where to grow next, which customers and channels to prioritize and what to stop doing.
- [Scale Strategy](https://parkland.consulting/services/scale-strategy/): The systems, tools, customer-facing experience and team readiness to grow without breaking what works.
- [Communication Strategy](https://parkland.consulting/services/communication-strategy/): How a brand speaks to customers, teams and partners across channels.
- [All services and engagement options](https://parkland.consulting/services/): Project work from $7,500, advisory from $3,500 per month, fractional leadership from $6,500 per month.
